steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Get Started with SnakeLite Open the SnakeLite bot on Telegram, link your TON wallet, and start earning coins by completing quests and inviting friends.
2 Step 2 : Log into SonicX Access SonicX using your TikTok account. Complete quests and invite friends to earn rewards, with your Solana wallet automatically connected to your TikTok.
3 Step 3 : Embark on the Sonic Odyssey Dive into the Sonic Odyssey to unlock additional quests and exclusive rewards. Compete, earn points, and advance through this thrilling adventure.
